newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Jan 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Britain's Rolls-Royce wins $500 million Emirates deal.
- UAE offset group sets up 55 million dirham shipping firm.
- Syrian officials to visit UAE as part of Gulf tour.
- Up to 200 foreign firms vie for UAE airport free trade zone slots.
- Dubai gold prices lower, demand slow to emerge.
- Trade between Britain and Gulf Arab states rose 20 percent in the first 11 months of 1996.
